<Subject 2> is the lily pond in space: round floating green lily pads, white water lilies that glow like stars, stars and nebulae, rings of light that spread through space like ripples on still water.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing a low view skimming just above the glowing river of stars, large lily pads and glowing white lilies drifting close on the left and right, the river curving ahead toward a small round planet glowing softly at the center of the horizon.
<Picture 2> is the last frame of [Shot 1], showing an eye-level view of a small round planet covered entirely by a calm pond, centered and filling the middle third of the frame, its curved surface a mirror of still deep teal water dotted with lily pads and white water lilies, one lily glowing gold at its top, soft rings of light rippling outward into space, the river of stars curving behind it.

detailed_description:
The target video is a living painterly illustration in <Subject 1>: brushstroke texture stays visible as everything moves, motion is slow, gentle and dreamlike.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The camera glides forward at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move, rising slightly as the river of stars curves away beneath it and passes behind the planet. The lily pads at the sides of the frame drift out of view. The small glowing planet ahead grows steadily larger until it fills the middle third of the frame, and its surface becomes clear: a curved mirror of still deep teal water dotted with round green lily pads and white water lilies, one lily glowing gold at its top. Soft rings of light ripple outward from the planet into space, one after another, in a slow rhythm. Its rim catches a warm golden light. The camera is still drifting slowly toward the planet as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
A deep, warm cosmic hum that grows as the planet nears, a soft pulse with each ring of light, faint water lapping from the planet's surface.
